rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the committee's concerns regarding headline inflation, the moderation of core inflation to 4.10% confirms that the current repo rate of 6.50% is sufficiently restrictive. The persistence of food inflation at 8.70% is a supply-side issue that requires targeted administrative measures rather than further monetary tightening. Maintaining a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance when the real rate is already in positive territory risks over-tightening and unnecessarily dampening the 6.50% GVA growth momentum. To ensure the durability of the recovery while anchoring expectations, a shift to a neutral stance is the most appropriate policy signal at this juncture.
